semantic_gate: Independent real-picture and text-marker matrix over history availability, cursor and marker rows, height targets, active/inactive primary and repeated resize, in both parser lanes; existing terminal tests; no promotion if any failure.
performance: No performance claim until semantic gate passes. No shipping executable replacement.
